description: This Java source file defines the 'ModuleResourcesServlet' class, which extends HttpServlet to serve module-specific resources within the OpenMRS framework. It handles HTTP GET requests to serve static files related to modules, determining file paths, managing caching, and handling errors.

classes.name: ModuleResourcesServlet
classes.description: A servlet class for serving static resources associated with a specific module in the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: getLastModified
methods.description: Overrides HttpServlet's method to provide last modified timestamp for caching based on the requested resource file.

methods.name: doGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to serve resource files, setting appropriate response headers and streaming file contents.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Resolves the file path based on the HTTP request, module information, and development environment considerations.
